The Scrum Master owns process facilitation, team flow, impediment removal, and sprint-level transparency while partnering closely with the Project Manager and Technical Lead. Education Bachelor's degree preferred. Certified ScrumMaster (CSM), PMI-ACP, SAFe Scrum Master, or equivalent Agile certification required. Facilitate collaboration between developers, QA, Technical Lead, Product Owner/business stakeholders, Project Manager, and operations/security participants. Promote continuous improvement by turning retrospective actions and recurring impediments into owned, measurable improvements. Maintain accurate Agile tooling and ensure sprint status reflects the actual state of work. Core Technical Skills Agile/Scrum facilitation, servant leadership, coaching, conflict resolution, and impediment management. Jira, Azure DevOps, or equivalent backlog/sprint tooling. Sprint metrics, flow/predictability analysis, dependency coordination, and continuous improvement. Time after time, programs failed because the focus was on the tools and products and not the people using them. LEARN MORE . NuAxis is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background investigation. LEARN MORE about our Benefits and Culture! #NAI #DICE

review_candidates.description: Job Title: Agile Technical Project Manager / Scrum Master Focus Area 1 : MPAS-UFS Integration Location : MD, DC, VA Preferred - Remote Clearance Required: Public Trust Eligible Salary : $115k-$130K Based on Years of Experience Application Deadline : September 30, 2026 To apply , please follow these steps: Visit https://ibsscorp.com/careers/ Select the position you are interested in Review the job details, then click Apply Now Complete and submit your application Overview IBSS is seeking highly qualified candidates to potentially provide Agile program and project management services for NOAA's Modeling Moonshot Initiative. The work supports multi-organization scientific R&D programs with substantial software components and is distinct from IT program management. The multi-year NOAA Modeling Moonshot Initiative advances U.S. leadership in Numerical Weather Prediction (NWP) through GPU-accelerated modeling, continuous data assimilation (DA), AI-augmented ensemble prediction, and NOAA's transition to the Model for Prediction Across Scales (MPAS) dynamical core. Its Research-to-Operations (R2O) focus prioritizes moving advanced capabilities into NOAA's operational forecast suite through coordination among NOAA offices, federal laboratories, and scientific partners. The Moonshot encompasses four interconnected technical focus areas: MPAS integration into the Unified Forecast System (UFS) for the next-generation Global Forecast System (GFS). Continuous DA using a global km-scale Joint Effort for Data Assimilation Integration (JEDI)-MPAS system. GPU acceleration and UFS refactoring for advanced hardware, cloud, and high-performance computing. AI for NWP (AI4NWP), including emulation, hybrid physics/AI models, and training datasets. The services will operate across all four areas, providing WPO with program visibility, dependency and risk management, R2O tracking, deliverable coordination, and stakeholder engagement. Although not performing scientific or software development, personnel must understand NWP, scientific computing, and Agile development to engage technical staff and coordinate effectively. Position Summary Provides science-aware Agile facilitation for one or more MPAS-UFS integration teams. Helps teams plan, execute, review, and report integration work while connecting local impediments, interfaces, verification needs, and operational-transition evidence to the wider portfolio. Roles And Responsibilities Serve as Scrum Master/facilitator for assigned MPAS-UFS teams; prepare and facilitate planning, refinement, reviews, retrospectives, and coordination events. Maintain backlog hygiene and distinguish MPAS standalone scientific capability from UFS-integrated operational capability. Track dynamical-core integration, physics/coupling dependencies, workflows, post-processing, restart/reproducibility behavior, regression evidence, performance, documentation, and operational tests. Help teams define testable increments, hypotheses, configurations, datasets, acceptance evidence, and fit-for-purpose definitions of ready/done. Maintain impediments, actions, risks, decisions, and dependencies; escalate aging or cross-team items with options and mission/schedule impact. Produce iteration summaries and progress inputs showing evidence completed, readiness/gate movement, forecast variance, flow indicators, and decisions needed. Coordinate handoffs and interface decisions with Continuous DA, GPU/UFS modernization, AI4NWP, operational organizations, and external partners. Coach teams in version control, peer review, automated testing, reproducible environments, configuration management, and continuous integration where appropriate. Provide workload-surge coverage to other focus areas and contribute to common facilitation practices and continuous improvement. Required Qualifications MA/MS degree (or accepted equivalent). 8-10 years of experience in the technical area being managed and 8+ years of IT management experience. Demonstrated success managing engineering or scientific-software teams and organizing complex delivery-order project activities. Strong Agile facilitation, backlog management, risk/impediment escalation, reporting, coaching, and stakeholder-communication skills. Sufficient technical literacy to facilitate model integration, scientific verification, software workflow, and operational-readiness discussions. Preferred Qualifications Direct experience with MPAS, UFS, RRFS/REFS, NWP model integration, physics/coupling, workflows, verification, or operational implementation. CSM, PSM, SAFe Scrum Master, PMI-ACP, or comparable certification. Experience supporting NOAA/OAR, NWS, EPIC, NCAR, DTC, or community earth-system modeling programs. Experience with CI/CD, DevSecOps, regression testing, HPC scheduling constraints, configuration baselines, and reproducibility. Advanced Smartsheet, Google Workspace, issue-tracking, dashboard, and technical-reporting skills. About IBSS Corp. review_candidates.title: Software development delivery
review_candidates.description: Company Description Stitch® is redefining customer engagement with AI-driven solutions tailored to each client’s business needs. The company’s platform automates customer service, personalizes marketing, and supports sales by connecting every touchpoint into a unified experience. Stitch® combines cutting-edge artificial intelligence with deep industry insights to help organizations deliver smarter, faster, and more personalized interactions. Team members work with modern technologies and innovative approaches that directly influence how businesses interact with their customers. Role Description This is a full-time, on-site role based in Heliopolis, focused on software development delivery within Stitch®’s AI-powered customer engagement platform. The role involves coordinating and executing end-to-end delivery of software features and releases, collaborating with engineering, product, and quality teams to ensure timely and reliable deployment. Responsibilities include translating business requirements into technical tasks, monitoring progress, resolving delivery bottlenecks, and supporting continuous improvement of development and release processes. The person in this role will track delivery metrics, communicate status and risks to stakeholders, and help maintain high standards for performance, scalability, and user experience across the platform. Qualifications Demonstrated experience in software development delivery, release management, or technical project coordination, preferably in SaaS or AI-driven products. Strong understanding of software development lifecycles (Agile/Scrum or similar), version control, and CI/CD pipelines. Ability to translate business and product requirements into clear technical tasks and delivery plans. Experience collaborating closely with engineering, product, QA, and operations teams to manage and streamline releases. Solid analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify delivery risks, propose mitigation strategies, and improve processes. Effective written and verbal communication skills, including clear documentation and stakeholder updates. Attention to detail and strong organizational skills to manage multiple concurrent initiatives and deadlines. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Familiarity with cloud platforms, APIs, and modern software architectures; prior exposure to AI or data-driven products is a plus. Commitment to inclusive, collaborative teamwork and openness to learning new tools and methodologies.

review_candidates.title: Data Visualization Designer (Communications Specialist)
review_candidates.description: This role is on-site in Washington, D.C at the Navy Yard. There are no remote opportunities. Active secret clearance is required. Job Description Build and maintain PowerPoint products for decision briefs, governance forums, program reviews, and headquarters engagements, working from rough content supplied by action officers and technical subject matter experts. Design charts, tables, timelines, organizational views, and process diagrams that make comparison, trend, dependency, and risk visible at a glance, selecting the chart form that fits the underlying data rather than defaulting to the template. Rebuild inherited slides that are technically accurate but visually unreadable, reducing text density, correcting hierarchy, and imposing a consistent visual grammar across a deck. Own slide masters, layouts, color and type systems, and reusable component libraries so that products remain consistent across many authors and multiple briefing cycles. Produce the graphic elements required for data presentation, including custom vector icons, callouts, annotation systems, and modular diagram components. Apply corporate and government template standards, required document markings, and accessibility requirements including sufficient color contrast and colorblind safe palettes. Maintain version control and source traceability so that every figure can be tied back to the data that produced it, and so that late changes to a number propagate correctly. Hold quality under compressed timelines. Tasking frequently arrives late, changes after it arrives, and is due before the next senior forum. Job Requirements Bachelor's degree in graphic design, information or communication design, data visualization, statistics, journalism, or a related field. Demonstrated equivalent skill will be accepted in lieu of a degree. One to three years of relevant experience. Internship, academic, freelance, student publication, and personal project work all count toward this. Candidates at the entry level are encouraged to apply. Advanced PowerPoint proficiency, including slide masters and layouts, alignment and distribution tools, merge shapes, the selection pane, and vector editing inside the application. Keyboard driven working habits are expected. Demonstrated ability to build charts from raw data in Excel, including pivot tables and formatting well beyond default chart output. Working command of visual design fundamentals: grid and alignment, typographic hierarchy, contrast, use of negative space, and restraint in color. Ability to take disorganized source material and return a coherent visual argument with limited supervision and limited subject matter hand holding. Precise written English and a high tolerance for detail work at the headquarters level. Experience with Power BI, Tableau, or Advana, including publishing figures intended for a briefing rather than for a dashboard. Adobe Illustrator and InDesign, used for figure production and document layout. Familiarity with Navy or DOD briefing conventions, including standard decision brief structure and classification and CUI marking requirements. Ability to produce simple explanatory graphics for technical subject matter such as network architecture, identity services, or cloud hosting. Basic scripting or automation experience, for example Python or VBA, applied to repetitive chart or deck production. A portfolio is mandatory. Applications submitted without one will not be reviewed. Candidates should submit a PDF or a link to an online portfolio containing, at minimum, the following. Three or more figures or slides in which the candidate began with raw or messy data and produced the final visual, each accompanied by one or two sentences explaining why that chart form was chosen over the alternatives. At least one before and after pair showing a dense or poorly structured slide rebuilt for clarity, with the original included. At least one multi slide sequence demonstrating consistency of layout, type, and color across a set rather than a single polished one off. Willingness to provide native source files or to walk the panel through construction of a selected item, so that the panel can confirm the candidate built the artifact rather than restyled a purchased template. The anticipated salary range for this role is $125,000 to $145,000 annually. The anticipated salary range for this position is provided in accordance with applicable pay transparency laws. The final starting salary will be determined based on a variety of job-related factors, including the selected candidate's qualifications, skills, relevant experience, education, certifications, and work location (where applicable), as well as internal equity and market considerations. We use E-Verify to confirm the identity and employment eligibility of all new hires.

Apply emerging technologies - such as generative AI, cloud platforms, automation tools, or DevOps practices - based on project needs and team direction. Build and integrate APIs, data connections, and service components that enable secure and reliable system interoperability. Support debugging, troubleshooting, and performance improvements across application and system components.
